version.author: Giorgio Robino
version.changelog: 0.6.1 Packaging fix: 0.6.0 was indexed with the includes under their old names (midi_cc_*.jsfx-inc), so it could not load. Everything is renamed after the package here. Use this version. 0.6.0 CCScope: renamed from "MIDI CC Visualizer" (the package is a new file, ccscope.jsfx: uninstall the old one, it is no longer in the repository). Readable: one colour per (CC, channel) instead of per CC, labelled time axis, metrics that degrade instead of running off the edge, plain value next to each bar, Freeze and Clear, exact 1 s window (counts were up to 10% high), 500 events/s per pair instead of 200, jitter that ignores gaps, reports how many intervals it used, and says n/a when there are too few to mean anything. 0.5.2 Correctness pass: the (CC, channel) key no longer overflows its memory range, slider 1 filters the graph and the bars together, bars can no longer be drawn under the status line, the metrics block and the event timestamps are sized and taken correctly (jitter was quantised to the audio block and offset by the callback's scheduling). 0.5.1 Cleaner bar layout: explicit "Events:/Rate:/Jitter:" labels, no pipe separators 0.5 Multi-channel support: CC data, colors and metrics tracked per (CC#, channel)

version.author: Giorgio Robino
version.changelog: 0.7.2 The three metrics are columns, not a sentence. Messages, Motion and Timing now start at fixed x, and inside them the numbers are aligned at their right edge, so 6, 16 and 123 end on the same pixel and the quality words (slow/fast, steady/erratic) no longer push what follows them.
